changelog:
Initial release of the GitVerse skill.

- Integrates with the GitVerse API for repository, issue, and pull request management.
- Supports listing/viewing repositories, issues, and pull requests; creating pull requests; viewing repository info.
- CLI usage included for all primary GitVerse operations.
- Requires GITVERSE_TOKEN for authentication.
- Outputs all data in JSON format.
summary: GitVerse API integration for working with repositories, issues, and pull requests. Use when Codex needs to interact with GitVerse (gitverse.ru) for operation...
